def max_Product(nums):
    nums.sort()
    left = 0
    right = len(nums) - 1
    max_product = nums[left] * nums[right]
    result = (nums[left], nums[right])
    while left < right and nums[left] * nums[right] == max_product:
        if nums[left] * nums[right] > max_product:
            max_product = nums[left] * nums[right]
            result = (nums[left], nums[right])
        left += 1
        right -= 1
    return result
